title: The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In the kingdom of Palettia, where magic marks nobility, Princess Anisphia cannot cast spells but uses memories of a past life to invent magical gadgets. When her brother, Crown Prince Algard, publicly breaks off his engagement to the gifted Euphyllia, Anisphia whisks her away as a live-in research assistant. Together they fight a dragon and a vampire crisis, Algard is exiled after trying to seize power, and Euphyllia makes a covenant with a spirit to take the throne in Anisphia's place, confessing her love.
life_message: Pursue your dreams with curiosity, and let love mean freeing the person you care for to be who they are.
